version.changelog: Initial release: all eleven bounded read-only Google Play production API operations with payment and secret-safety guidance.

llm.summary: This skill documents a read-only paid API for public Google Play data and clearly limits credential handling and write actions.

dimensions.detail: The skill uses terminal curl commands, network access to api.replynodes.com, and a metered ReplyNodes API key, which is proportionate to its API-query purpose and disclosed with payment and secret-handling cautions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The inspected artifact contains markdown documentation only; no executable scripts, install hooks, or automatic setup behavior were present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to validating inputs, URL-encoding parameters, checking capabilities and pricing, using a ReplyNodes bearer key, and avoiding Google credentials, cookies, account access, catalog enumeration, and write operations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, background workers, privilege escalation, local indexing, credential store access, or mutation authority is requested; the only credential guidance is to keep the ReplyNodes key in an environment variable and out of logs and reports.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is querying public Android app data, and the documented capabilities are GET-only routes for app metadata, search, reviews, permissions, availability, and related public store information.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, confirm you are comfortable using a paid third-party ReplyNodes API key for public Google Play lookups. Keep the key in an environment variable, check capabilities and price before batches, and avoid sending Google account credentials or running unbounded pagination.
